generate_model_response.description: Send a prompt to a Mistral AI model and get back its written response.

mock_response.response_text: Here is a thoughtful response to your question about artificial intelligence and its applications in modern software development.

generate_model_response.name: generate_model_response

parameters.description: The message or question to send to Mistral.
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Optional instructions that set the model's role, tone, or output format for this request (e.g. 'You are a concise support agent. Reply in two sentences.').
parameters.name: system_prompt

parameters.description: Which Mistral model to use. Defaults to mistral-large-latest.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: Maximum number of tokens Mistral may generate in its response. Raise it for longer replies. Leave blank to use the model's own default.
parameters.name: max_tokens

parameters.description: How varied the response should be, from 0 (focused and predictable) to 1.5 (more creative). Mistral recommends staying between 0 and 0.7. Leave blank to use the model's own default.
parameters.name: temperature

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens the response used.

finish_reason.description: Why the model stopped generating, e.g. 'stop' when it finished or 'length' when it hit the response limit.

model.description: The Mistral model that produced the response.

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens the prompt used.

response_text.description: The text Mistral generated for your prompt.

total_tokens.description: Total tokens billed for this request.

description: Connect Mistral AI's chat models to answer questions, write text, and generate content in your workflows.
